records.title: RL's Razor: Why Online Reinforcement Learning Forgets Less
records.reason: The methods compare fine-tuning objectives and prior-task retention; evaluation is learning/forgetting tradeoffs. The serving-runtime lineage link does not reflect a technical runtime contribution.

records.title: Very Deep Self-Attention Networks for End-to-End Speech Recognition
records.reason: The work is a speech-recognition architecture from 2019; it tests deep self-attention ASR and training regularization, while retaining the full network at inference. Transfer to current LLM inference efficiency is weak.

records.title: Agent S2: A Compositional Generalist-Specialist Framework for Computer Use Agents
records.reason: The paper concerns computer-use agent architecture and task performance. It does not provide a concrete LLM inference-serving optimization, so its connection to inference-system lineages is indirect.

records.title: DS-Agent: Automated Data Science by Empowering Large Language Models with Case-Based Reasoning
records.reason: Case-based reasoning is used to improve data-science agent task solving, but the reported contribution does not establish inference-system savings or reusable context/KV mechanisms.

records.title: End-to-End Transformer-Based Models in Textual-Based NLP
records.reason: This is a broad survey of transformer-based textual NLP tasks and architectures. It notes attention complexity but does not focus on inference optimization methods or serving measurements.
